contract.intent: Implement and validate the portable AgentsKit Harness package and its CLI.

outOfScope: automatic git push or PR creation

outcomes.statement: The typed harness library builds, tests, and exposes a usable CLI from a clean checkout.
The contract, state machine, evidence, stale detection, and approval protocol are enforced.
The Playbook and package distribution metadata document the portable protocol and contribution workflow.

endpoint.reason: The initial vertical slice is a local library and CLI.

database.reason: The initial vertical slice has no database-backed behavior.

mcp.reason: MCP is an optional integration, not part of the initial CLI slice.

ui.reason: The initial vertical slice has no shipped UI.

checks.command: pnpm exec ak-harness --version && pnpm exec ak-harness --help >/dev/null && pnpm exec ak-harness doctor --json

tracking.reason: Local-first development; external tracking is conditional per task contract.
